description: This file defines a React component for the Deployments page in a dashboard application. It manages fetching deployment data from an API, displays charts of deployment statuses, and renders a data table with deployment details, including sorting and pagination functionality.

methods.name: toLabel
methods.description: Converts snake_case strings to Title Case labels for table headers.

methods.name: fmtDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a localized string, or returns a placeholder if invalid.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Builds column configuration for the DataTable component based on allowed fields and row data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches deployment data from the server with pagination and sorting options, updates state accordingly.
